title: V5 dedup-then-UNIQUE-INDEX migration is the correct upgrade path
description: Migration V5 DELETEs duplicate (chat_id, sender_msg_id) pairs before creating the UNIQUE INDEX, preserving the oldest row (MIN rowid). A contributor might suggest adding the index in V4 or skipping the dedup step; both would fail on any deployed instance that received retransmitted messages before the migration. The dedup-first approach is the only safe upgrade path for an index added after data is already present.
